stemMd: A retailer buys100 items at8 euros each. It sells60 items at12 euros each and all remaining items at a single discounted price. There are no other costs or revenues. Column "breakeven": choose the discounted price giving zero overall profit. Column "target": choose the discounted price giving200 euros overall profit.
instructionsMd: Select exactly one answer in each named column. Both selections must be correct. The project presents separate column lists rather than the official interface’s shared matrix or drop-down controls.
explanationMd: Total cost800 and first-stage revenue720 leave40 items. For break-even,720+40p=800 gives p=2. For profit200,720+40p=1000 gives p=7. Each target uses the same earlier sales; the second task does not use the first task’s price.

distractorRationale.breakeven-a: This recovers each remaining item’s unit cost but also adds profit from earlier sales.
